name: Al Noor Mosque, Christchurch
scope: Al Noor Mosque on Deans Avenue, Riccarton, in its June 2006 appearance. Includes the low precast building, gold dome and crescent, slim minaret and green geometric ornament.

originalReview.notes: The exact published Qualla crop removes 136 top and 80 bottom rows. Every remaining RGB pixel matches the photographer’s public-domain 2006 upload. The photograph shows the gold dome, green geometric panels, pale cladding and white-shaft minaret.

review.method: Exact Qualla original crop with equality against first public-domain upload
review.notes: The Qualla crop is mechanically derived from the creator’s original. Native upload log, original and crop checksums, and a decoded pixel comparison prove that it adds no pixels or creative editing. The later contrast and perspective edit is outside the reference set.
